messages: Samir (docs): heads up — my PR for the Console observability guide just went red in preview. I updated the tracing hook section but I think i accidentally renamed trace context keys from trace_id -> traceID, which broke the anchor refs and the examples. Elena (eng-obsv): saw the preview error too. Deploy preview link says a 404 on /docs/console/observability#tracing-hooks. likely the anchor slug mismatch from the header change. Samir (docs): exact diff in the PR: ```diff - ## Tracing hooks and trace_id + ## Tracing hooks and traceID ``` That header rename changed the generated anchor. I can revert but want to avoid churn if there are downstream links. Kai (infra): Deploy bot logged: `DocsBot: preview build failed - broken link /docs/console/observability#tracing-hooks -> 404` at 2991234578. Also markdownlint flagged `heading-increment` warning. DocsBot: preview build failed for PR #742 — broken internal link(s) found: `/docs/console/observability#tracing-hooks` -> not found. Jess (product): for any link churn we should add a permalink or keep the old anchor as an HTML anchor to be safe. Is it feasible to add an explicit `` above the header as a short-term fix? Samir (docs): yes i can add a hidden anchor to preserve the old slug and then open a follow-up PR to normalize headings. quick patch: ```html ## Tracing hooks and traceID ``` Elena (eng-obsv): that would work. But we also need to update the code snippet that uses `trace_id` in examples to `traceID` (or vice versa). Which canonical key are we standardizing on? Marta (devex): recommendation: keep snake_case `trace_id` in payloads (matches most SDKs) and map to camelCase only in client bindings. So revert header rename to `trace_id` and keep examples consistent. Less surprising for customers. Samir (docs): ok i'll revert the heading to `Tracing hooks and trace_id` and update the code samples. I will also add the hidden anchor as a belt-and-suspenders step. Planning to push in the next 10m. Kai (infra): ping me when you push — i'll re-run the preview job manually and check the link report. Also please run `yarn docs:lint` locally; the lint job failed in CI for an unrelated `MD013` line length in the same file. Samir (docs): noted. i'll run lint, revert the header, fix samples, add anchor, and push. patch snippet: ```diff - ## Tracing hooks and traceID + + ## Tracing hooks and trace_id ``` Jess (product): thanks. once green, can we also add a short note in the changelog/Docs Changelog that we preserved the old anchor for a short window? PMs have links to the old slug in a few internal tickets. Samir (docs): will add a changelog bullet. also creating issue #1195 to track normalizing header slugs across Console docs so we don't do ad-hoc renames. Elena (eng-obsv): when you update the code snippet, please include both variants and a short note: "SDKs commonly use trace_id; API payloads accept traceID as legacy alias" — that reduces support tickets. Samir (docs): good idea. snippet will show both and explain mapping. Kai (infra): preview re-run passed for me locally after the revert + anchor + lint fix. DocsBot still: `preview succeeded` for PR #742 at 2991234590. DocsBot: preview build succeeded for PR #742 — no broken links found. Marta (devex): can someone add a short test to the docs QA checklist: "verify internal anchors after header edits"? we've tripped on this 3x this quarter. Jess (product): adding to next week's docs retro agenda. thanks all. :tada: Samir (docs): pushed and linked changelog + created normalization issue. closing the loop here. anyone want to review the quick patch? small PR so cc @Elena @Kai for quick LGTM. Elena (eng-obsv): LGTM. Kai (infra): LGTM. Samir (docs): thanks — will merge after CI completes.
